shape: someone who lives far away now, and the one small habit you both kept

slides.text: four hundred miles apart, but you still send [[the screenshot of mum's text]] before i even open it.

caption:
we haven't shared a hallway in six years, but my phone still buzzes the second she hits send.
no extra words attached, because you already know what face i am making.
send this to your sister if she always sends the screenshot first.

#siblings #sisterlove #siblinglove #oldersiblings
alt: a small green donkey wearing glasses with a knowing look, above text about a sister sending screenshots of mum's text.
